name: dth/commercial
description: DTH Commercial module: service catalog, service packages and business opportunities with optional CRM, Marketing and Email integration.

suggest.filament/filament: Provides the optional Commercial administration UI.
suggest.dth/marketing: Lets Marketing select services/packages through CatalogProvider.
suggest.dth/crm: Lets qualified CRM leads hand off into Commercial opportunities.
suggest.dth/email: Email Campaigns can display Marketing offer context when linked to a Marketing Campaign.
